title: The Mason's Ledger
goalText: Strike every wall, pay the crew, fix Bram's name, cut Mira's note, and add a door at the end.

scripts.title: The Mason's ledger
scripts.goalText: Strike every wall, pay the crew, fix Bram's name, cut Mira's note, and add a door at the end.
startLines: Mira ....... unpaid  (owed since the Last Saving)
hints: Press `dd` on a wall row to strike it. `.` repeats a change.
Cursor on the u of unpaid, press `2x`. Then `j` and `.` for each row below.
Cursor on the e of Brem, press `r` then `a` to make it Bram.
On Mira's row, cursor just after paid, press `D` to cut the note.
Last step: press `o` under the last row, type door, then `Esc`.
